function: Screw-fastened cabin enclosure for a proposed protected ESP32 LED carrier, with separately supported pigtails

roles.case_base: Printed structural tub and carrier supports
roles.case_lid: Removable flat lid retained by four M3 screws
roles.carrier: Proposed 90 x 62 x 1.6 mm PCB reference, not a completed electrical board
roles.controller: Estimated 72 x 57 x 25 mm reserved volume, owned component not verified
roles.insert_coupon: Pilot-hole fit study in the actual print process

frame: Case body minimum XY at 0,0; underside Z=0; ears extend X to -7 and 123
permitted_contacts: lid underside against rim and corner posts
load_path: Pigtail to tie bridge/case; carrier screws to bosses and floor; lid screws to corner posts; case floor/ears to an independently verified console mount
keepouts: actual antenna and surrounding conductors to be measured
actual USB plug and extraction path to be measured
vehicle shifter/switch/moving-trim sweep to be measured
carrier screwdriver access with controller removed only
wire bundle bend radius and tug restraint to be measured

service_states.name: insert_installation
service_states.state: Empty tub; insert tool vertical to each pocket
service_states.verified: nominal CAD only; physical process pending

service_states.name: carrier_installation
service_states.state: Lid and controller removed; carrier seated on four bosses
service_states.verified: exported-solid static interference check against proposed carrier

service_states.name: normal_operation
service_states.state: Lid closed; cables restrained; new LEDs on a protected circuit
service_states.verified: estimated-envelope CAD check only; electrical and vehicle states unverified

service_states.name: bench_service
service_states.state: Vehicle power disconnected; lid removed; USB access after verifying owned-board geometry

service_states.name: removal
service_states.state: Disconnect mating harness, release independent cable support and mounting hardware
service_states.verified: vehicle mounting and connected extraction pending

manufacturing_context.seam: rigid flat joint without a gasket or ingress rating

analysis_regions.support: mounting-ear bores and floor at installed mounting surface, actual fixture unknown
analysis_regions.load: pigtail pull at tie bridges and retained board mass under vibration, magnitudes unknown
